mechanics.summary: A zip gun can be jury rigged using one weapon or general spare part.
inputs: one weapon or general spare part

mechanics.summary: M79 and M203 40mm grenades are spin-armed and do not detonate under 15 meters (two hexes).
An M16 or M4 fitted with an M203 has a -1 shooting modifier.
trigger: M16 or M4 is fitted with M203 and fired

mechanics.summary: An MK 19 must be mounted on a tripod or a pintle.
The MK 19 uses ammo dice; ammo-die successes add grenade outcomes as specified for a hit or miss.

value.hit: each ammo-die success lands an additional grenade in the target hex or adjacent hex; against a specific target, it can score another hit on that target or a secondary target in the same or adjacent hex
value.miss: roll deviation one additional time per ammo-die success

unknowns: Target and adjacent-hex choices require resolution context.

mechanics.summary: A FGM-148 top-attack missile uses the target vehicle's rear armor rating.
A GP-25 grenade does not detonate closer than 10 meters from the muzzle.
The AGS-17 uses ammo dice; ammo-die successes add grenade outcomes as specified for a hit or miss.

value.hit: each ammo-die success lands an additional grenade in the target hex or adjacent hex; against a specific target, it can score another hit on that target or a secondary target in the same or adjacent hex
value.miss: roll deviation one additional time per ammo-die success

unknowns: Target and adjacent-hex choices require resolution context.
